C0519.title: Claude Code Source Code Leak: An In-Depth Analysis of Community Reverse Engineering Techniques
C0519.summary: Around March 31, 2026, Anthropic released Claude Code v2.1.88 without excluding cli.js.map and related source map files from the package. The referenced article states that the source map's sourcesContent field directly contained source code, so roughly 512,000 lines of TypeScript could be restored with a script without decompilation or reverse engineering. Mirror repositories and many forks then appeared on GitHub, after which Anthropic removed the source maps and submitted a DMCA takedown notice to GitHub.

references.title: Claude Code Source Code Leak: A Public Lesson in AI Engineering Worth Hundreds of Millions
